main_body: stone brick paving or wall surface
evidence: This is a repeating terrain/paving tile pattern, which naturally uses a flat surface projection appropriate for terrain.

style.evidence: The paving uses 5 warm grey-brown tones with beveled highlights and dark mortar joints, but the interior of the large bricks (e.g. rows 9-13, 14x5 area) is mostly a single flat mid-tone with only 2-3 isolated speckle pixels, making it much flatter and more repetitive than the intricate cobblestone Beodeul reference.
